summary: Tested new public Apps Script code pages for Mondo Noleggio. All 4 backend pytest tests passed (GET /api/codice -> 200 HTML with correct title/button/pre+TOKEN+doPost; GET /api/sheet-script/<valid_token> -> 200 same HTML; GET /api/sheet-script/wrongtoken -> 404; GET /api/admin/sheet/script with admin JWT still returns 200 with injected TOKEN). Opened the public page in a real browser via Playwright at desktop (1280x800) and mobile (375x667) viewports: page title 'Codice Apps Script – Mondo Noleggio', H2, button '📋 Copia codice' and <pre id='c'> all render; clicking the button (with clipboard permissions granted) correctly changes its text to '✅ Copiato!' on both viewports and copies the Apps Script code to the clipboard. Navigating to /api/sheet-script/wrongtoken in the browser returns HTTP 404 as expected. No console errors on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_sheet_script reads apps_script.gs twice and calls admin_sheet_script({}) with a fake dependency arg to reuse logic — works but fragile. Minor refactor opportunity: extract a build_script() helper used by both endpoints.

User complaint 'il link non si apre' is NOT reproducible from backend/browser side. Endpoints respond 200 and the page is interactive. Likely a client-side issue (e.g. user tapped a non-link, mail-client blocked preview URL, or opened in an app that stripped the path). Suggest main agent send user both URLs (/api/codice and /api/sheet-script/<token>) as plain tappable links and verify from user's device.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public endpoints GET /api/codice and GET /api/sheet-script/{SHEET_SCRIPT_TOKEN} return a self-contained HTML page with a Copia codice button that copies the Apps Script code (TOKEN substituted from env). Wrong token -> 404. Admin JSON endpoint /api/admin/sheet/script also works. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_sheet_script_public.py. BASE_URL used: https://bici-disponibili.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
rca_of_issue: User-reported 'il link non si apre' could not be reproduced: both the /api/codice shortcut and /api/sheet-script/<token> URLs load correctly (HTTP 200, valid HTML, clipboard button works) on desktop and mobile viewports; invalid tokens correctly return 404. The implementation in server.py:517-531 is correct. Most likely cause on user side: link was tapped inside an in-app browser/email client that failed to resolve the preview domain, or the user copied an incomplete URL. Recommend main agent re-share both the /api/codice (short) and /api/sheet-script/<token> URLs and ask the user which browser they used.
